description: Permanently delete a gameserver database with all its tables and data (no undo). Get an explicit yes first. confirmationName must be the exact database name (field `database`). Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

confirmationName.description: The exact database name (field `database` of list_gameserver_databases), as typed in the dashboard.

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: delete_gameserver_database
title: Delete Game Server Database
